slug: 2024-09-18 Launch of New Digital Solutions for Public Services

SYC.note: The document says nothing about records passing between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of people holding an ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Department of Immigration & Civil Status, with the Department of Information Communications Technology, issues the NIN and ID letters and from 17 September 2024 issues virtual ID cards on the SeyID platform instead of physical cards for permit holders.

SYC.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Seychelles ICS assigns a National Identity Number and, from 17 September 2024, issues permit holders a virtual ID card on the SeyID platform; Seychellois abroad can also register for it.
